name: recruit-radar
description: Evidence-backed hiring-market intelligence: normalized job postings, identity resolution, explainable scoring.

scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run backend:lint && npm run backend:format && npm run backend:types && npm run backend:test && npm run vectors:check && npm run fuzz && npm run build && npm run secrets && npm run e2e
scripts.backend:lint: node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff check backend contracts/tools
scripts.backend:format: node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff format --check backend contracts/tools
scripts.fuzz: node scripts/py.mjs contracts/tools/fuzz_diff.py all --seed 1 --count 800 && node scripts/py.mjs contracts/tools/fuzz_csv.py --seed 1 --count 600
